questions.question: What does Brown Pixels build?
questions.answer: Brown Pixels designs and builds business websites, web applications, custom business systems, AI-enabled products and workflow automation. Digital presence and marketing support are also available.

questions.question: Can you build software around our existing process?
questions.answer: Yes. Projects are shaped around the people, workflows, data and requirements involved, rather than forcing a business into a generic system.

questions.question: What kinds of businesses do you work with?
questions.answer: Brown Pixels works with businesses, startups, professionals and growing companies. The right scope and technology depend on the project.

questions.question: Do you provide AI and automation services?
questions.answer: Yes. Services include AI assistants, integrations, API-based AI applications and automation for business workflows where these tools provide practical value.

questions.question: What business software can Brown Pixels build?
questions.answer: Brown Pixels scopes custom ERP and CRM workflows, web applications, portals, internal tools and reporting around the people, processes and information involved.

questions.question: Can you add WhatsApp enquiries or messaging to a project?
questions.answer: Website enquiry links and handoffs can be included where they suit the project. More automated messaging or system connections are assessed against the available platform access and agreed requirements.

questions.question: Where is Brown Pixels based and where can you work?
questions.answer: Brown Pixels is based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, and can discuss projects with businesses in Karur, Trichy and other suitable locations. Initial project discussions can take place online; no branch offices in those cities are claimed.

questions.question: How can I discuss a project?
questions.answer: Use the project enquiry form on this page or contact Brown Pixels by email or WhatsApp. Share your goals and a short description of what you need.
